abstract: BACKGROUND: Choriocarcinoma is a highly malignant trophoblastic tumor. However, the awareness surrounding its atypical clinical presentation is insufficient. The presence of a solitary lung lesion without uterine lesions often leads to misdiagnosis or missed diagnosis, which in turn causes delayed treatment or even multiple metastases throughout the body. CASE PRESENTATION: We present the case of a 36-year-old female patient who was misdiagnosed with a lung abscess and received suboptimal anti-infective treatment. She then underwent left upper lobectomy and was misdiagnosed with lung cancer by abscess incision and drainage in thoracic surgery, however, the results after pleural effusion removal were suboptimal. During this time a breast nodule was found, and a large segment of the right breast was excised and misdiagnosed as breast cancer but was finally diagnosed as choriocarcinoma with multiple metastases of lung and breast. Multiple metastases were also detected in the head, liver, kidney, and bones. The patient underwent multiple adjuvant chemotherapies. The blood β-hCG level gradually declined to normal. When we reported this case, that is, seven months after the diagnosis, the patient was still alive, and the disease was stable without progress. CONCLUSION: Choriocarcinoma with a solitary lung lesion as the first presentation and no lesions in the uterus is clinically rare. This may lead to a delay in diagnosis due to poor awareness of the disease and the appearance of multiple metastases throughout the body. Clinicians should be more aware of choriocarcinoma with an atypical presentation to reduce misdiagnosis and missed diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 背景：絨毛癌は非常に悪性度の高い栄養膜腫瘍である。しかし、その非典型的な臨床像についての認識は不十分である。子宮病変を伴わない孤立性肺病変は、誤診または見逃しにつながることが多く、その結果、治療の遅れや全身への多発転移を招くことがある。症例提示：36歳の女性患者が肺膿瘍と誤診され、不十分な抗感染症治療を受けた。その後、左上葉切除術を受けたが、胸部外科での膿瘍切開排膿により肺がんと誤診され、胸水除去後も結果は不十分であった。この間に乳房結節が発見され、右乳房の大部分を切除したが、乳がんと誤診された。最終的には、肺および乳房への多発転移を伴う絨毛癌と診断された。頭部、肝臓、腎臓、骨にも多発転移が認められた。患者は複数回の補助化学療法を受けた。血中β-hCG値は徐々に正常値まで低下した。本症例を報告した時点、すなわち診断から7か月後には、患者は生存しており、病状は進行せず安定していた。結論：子宮に病変がなく、孤立性肺病変を初発症状とする絨毛癌は臨床的に稀である。この疾患に対する認識が不十分であるため、診断の遅れや全身への多発転移を招くおそれがある。誤診や見逃しを減らすため、臨床医は非典型的な経過を示す絨毛癌をより認識すべきである。
